title: Analysis code for 'Shifting from plant functional types to traits: Enhancing biodiversity representation in land surface models' (SHIFT Dangermond)
description:
Analysis code (data processing, trait retrieval/inversion, CliMA Land simulations, and figures) for Braghiere et al., "Shifting from plant functional types to traits: Enhancing biodiversity representation in land surface models" (Ecosphere, ECS25-0887.R1).

The CliMA Land model (Emerald v0.3.0) used by these scripts is archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21479295; see REPRODUCE.md for the environment and reproduction steps. Datasets are archived at the Caltech Data Library (https://doi.org/10.22002/z15fj-44h89) and the ORNL DAAC. This study builds on the SHIFT campaign (Chadwick et al., 2025, https://doi.org/10.1002/ecs2.70194).
